senses.gloss:
चौल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Relating to a crest or top-knot, &c.
 E. चूला for
चूडा, and अण् aff.

चौलकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The ceremony of tonsure, cutting of all the hair
from the head of a child three years old, except one lock on the
crown.
 E. चौल or चोड relating to the चूडा or crest, and कर्म्मन्
work, act.
